tagline: Focused on the acquisition, exploration and evaluation of mineral resource properties primarily in the western United States
hero_kpi_rationale: Reflects the company's primary investment in mineral exploration, the main driver of future value creation for a pre-production junior miner.

risks.title: Uncertainty regarding mineral reserves and their profitability
risks.score_rationale: Risk placed at the beginning of Item 1A with highly intensive language (« high risk, speculative venture », « no certainty »). Repeated multiple times throughout the document. Critical for a production-stage junior explorer. Categorically major weight for the mining sector.

risks.title: Absence of operating cash flow and reliance on financing
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned as a major risk: « no source of operating cash flow » and « no assurance that acceptable additional funding will be available ». Direct and repeated language. Critical for short- to medium-term viability. High weight for a junior explorer.

risks.title: Concentration of the portfolio on three mining properties
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly identified: « unless the Company acquires additional property interests, any adverse developments affecting these properties would have a material adverse effect ». Clear warning language. Major geographic and operational concentration risk.

risks.title: Uncertainties regarding ownership titles of mining claims
risks.score_rationale: Sector-specific risk in the U.S. mining industry, mentioned in detail: unpatented claims on BLM lands with possessory title only, leased properties with surface and mineral rights controlled by third parties. Repeated uncertainty language (« uncertainties », « may be contested »).

risks.title: Operational and environmental risks of mining exploration
risks.score_rationale: Detailed in Industry-Related Risks section with exhaustive enumeration: unexpected geological formations, flooding, cave-ins, environmental damage. Sector-specific language (« hazards and risks normally encountered »). Significant weight for mining operations.

risks.title: Dependence on licenses, permits, and regulatory compliance
risks.score_rationale: Specific regulatory risk mentioned in detail: government, exploration, development, environmental protection (sensitive species such as greater sage-grouse), cultural heritage, mining taxes. Uncertainty language: « no guarantee that licenses and permits will be granted ».

risks.title: Critical dependence on key management personnel
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned: Dennis Higgs (CEO), Robert Hatch (VP Exploration), Darcy Higgs (VP Business Development), Grant Bond (CFO). Language: « Loss of any of these people, particularly to competitors, could have a material adverse effect ». Moderate but identified risk.

risks.title: Extensive environmental and regulatory compliance
risks.score_rationale: Sector-specific regulatory risk in mining: air/water quality, mine reclamation, waste management, occupational health and safety. Language: « extensive governmental regulations » and « may require significant funds ». Moderate but increasing weight in the sector.

ai_positioning.summary: Austin Gold Corp. does not reference any strategy, technology, or application related to artificial intelligence in its financial or operational documents.
evidence: No mention of AI in the Business, MD&A, or Risk sections.
No reference to automated analysis tools, machine learning, or advanced digitalization.
